title: PhantomEnvironments: Training LLM Agents in Fictional Worlds
title_zh: PhantomEnvironments：在虚构世界中训练LLM智能体

paragraphs.en: Training LLM agents with reinforcement learning (RL) is bottlenecked by environments, which must provide verifiable rewards, support long-horizon interaction, and scale cheaply. Existing approaches rely on costly human-curated data or on LLM-generated environments that risk hallucinations and benchmark contamination. We show that LLMs can instead be trained into capable search agents using synthetic environments generated entirely by rules, whose generation requires no LLM and has zero marginal cost. We build PhantomEnvironments, multi-turn RL environments from fictional worlds, where agents must search a corpus of templated articles to answer multi-hop questions. Despite sharing no facts with the real world, these strikingly simple environments yield agents that transfer to real-world multi-hop search benchmarks, often outperforming real-world training data on newer benchmarks. Trained agents generalize to unseen fictional universes, and Qwen models learn to scale their search budget roughly linearly with question difficulty, suggesting emergent search scaling from environment interaction alone. Ablating environment complexity reveals that hop count drives transfer more than constraints or comparisons: even the simplest rule-generated environments are a surprisingly effective, free resource for training generalizable LLM agents.

paragraphs.en: Training LLM search agents with reinforcement learning (RL) is bottlenecked by environment curation. RL needs an environment the agent can interact with: one that yields long multi-turn trajectories, a verifiable reward at the end of each one, and multiple interactions. Building such environments at scale for RL is expensive. Wikipedia-grounded environments built from human-curated corpora like NaturalQuestions and HotpotQA require costly annotation and could tie the agent to a fixed Wikipedia snapshot ( Kwiatkowski et al., 2019 ; Yang et al., 2018 ; Jin et al., 2025b ) . LLM-synthesized environments use frontier models to create retrievals, questions, or whole task harnesses ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Goldie et al., 2025 ; Chang et al., 2026 ; Gandhi et al., 2026 ; Sullivan et al., 2025 ) . They reduce curation effort, but they introduce hallucinated rewards, benchmark contamination risk, API cost, and a capability ceiling set by the generator. The bottleneck in training LLM agents has shifted from optimization to the question of where verifiable, interactive, long-horizon environments should come from.
paragraphs.zh: 使用强化学习（RL）训练大型语言模型（LLM）搜索智能体时，环境构建成为瓶颈。 强化学习需要一个智能体能够与之交互的环境：该环境应能产生长期的多轮交互轨迹，在每轮结束时提供可验证的奖励，并支持多次交互。 为强化学习大规模构建此类环境成本高昂。 基于维基百科、由人工整理语料库（如 NaturalQuestions 和 HotpotQA）构建的环境需要耗费大量标注工作，且可能使智能体局限于某个固定的维基百科快照（Kwiatkowski et al., 2019；Yang et al., 2018；Jin et al., 2025b）。 基于大型语言模型合成的环境利用前沿模型生成检索结果、问题或完整的任务框架（Sun et al., 2025；Gao et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2026；Goldie et al., 2025；Chang et al., 2026；Gandhi et al., 2026；Sullivan et al., 2025）。 这些方法虽减少了环境构建的工作量，但也带来了幻觉奖励、基准污染风险、API 成本问题，以及由生成模型能力决定的性能上限。 训练大型语言模型智能体的瓶颈已从优化问题转向如何获取可验证、可交互且具有长期视野的环境这一问题。

paragraphs.en: We show that such an environment for training LLM agents can be designed by codified rules alone , with no humans and no LLMs in the pipeline. We turn fictional worlds and template-generated multi-hop questions of PhantomWiki ( Gong et al., 2025 ) into interactive multi-turn environments for RL fine-tuning LLMs, which we call PhantomEnvironments (PhantomEnvs for short). Such “rule-generated synthetic environments” are verifiable by construction and incur zero generation cost. Universe size, question difficulty, and question budget are knobs the experimenter sets directly, so such environments can scale to arbitrary sizes and complexity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，仅通过编码规则即可设计出用于训练 LLM 智能体的此类环境，而无需在流程中涉及人类或 LLM。 我们将 PhantomWiki（Gong 等人，2025）中的虚构世界和模板生成的多跳问题转化为交互式多轮环境，用于强化学习微调 LLM，我们将其称为 PhantomEnvironments（简称 PhantomEnvs）。 此类“规则生成的合成环境”可通过其构建过程进行验证，且无需任何生成成本。 宇宙规模、问题难度和问题预算均由实验者直接设定，因此这类环境可扩展至任意规模和复杂度。

paragraphs.en: A priori, there is little reason to expect simple synthetic environments to work. Fictional universes in these rule-generated synthetic environments share no entities, no facts, and no document distribution with any real-world benchmark. Articles are template-generated rather than human-written and the relational structure is a randomly sampled social graph—neither the linguistic richness nor the long-tailed topical structure of real-world corpora like Wikipedia. An agent trained here has no facts to memorize and no exposure to the linguistic variation it will face at evaluation, so the default expectation is that whatever it learns stays coupled to the templates and fails to transfer. Any transfer that does occur due to PhantomEnvironments must come from learning generalizable agentic search skills —decomposing questions, retrieving documents correctly, composing knowledge across turns.
paragraphs.zh: 从先验角度来看，几乎没有理由期待简单的合成环境能够奏效。 这些通过规则生成的合成环境中的虚构宇宙，与任何现实世界的基准数据都毫无实体、事实或文档分布上的共通之处。 其中的文章是模板生成的，而非人类撰写，其关系结构也是随机采样的社交网络——既不具备维基百科等现实世界语料库的语言丰富性，也缺乏其长尾主题结构。 在此训练的智能体既没有需要记忆的事实，也没有接触过评估时将要面对的语言多样性，因此默认预期是：无论它学到什么，都会与模板紧密绑定而无法迁移。 任何因 PhantomEnvironments 而发生的迁移，都必须源于对可泛化的智能体搜索技能的掌握——例如分解问题、正确检索文档以及跨轮次整合知识。

paragraphs.en: Yet, we empirically demonstrate significant and consistent transfer to real-world agentic search. We RL full fine-tune four LLMs (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Team, 2024 ) , Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , Phi-4-mini-instruct ( Microsoft et al., 2025 ) ) inside PhantomEnvironments and evaluate on a suite of six real-world multi-hop search benchmarks. Performance improves over the base model by roughly 1.7 × 1.7\times on the Wikipedia-2018-based benchmarks (HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) , 2WikiMultihopQA ( Ho et al., 2020 ) , MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) ) and 2.2 × 2.2\times on the newer-and-harder ones (SynthWorlds-RM, SynthWorlds-SM ( Gu et al., 2025 ) and FRAMES ( Krishna et al., 2025 ) ). We also find that trained Qwen models learn to allocate their search budget roughly linearly with question difficulty—an emergent search scaling behavior. To our knowledge, we are the first to show that off-the-shelf LLMs fine-tuned with RL on such rule-generated synthetic environments can create LLM search agents performant in the real-world.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，我们通过实证表明，这种方法能够显著且稳定地迁移到真实世界的智能体搜索任务中。 我们在 PhantomEnvironments 中对四个大型语言模型（Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct（Team, 2024）、Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct（Grattafiori et al., 2024）、Phi-4-mini-instruct（Microsoft et al., 2025））进行了完整的强化学习微调，并在六项真实世界多跳搜索基准测试套件上进行了评估。 在基于 Wikipedia-2018 的基准测试中（HotpotQA（Yang et al., 2018）、2WikiMultihopQA（Ho et al., 2020）、MuSiQue（Trivedi et al., 2022）），性能相比基础模型提升了约 1.7 × 1.7\times；而在更新且更具挑战性的基准测试中（SynthWorlds-RM、SynthWorlds-SM（Gu et al., 2025）以及 FRAMES（Krishna et al., 2025）），性能提升了约 2.2 × 2.2\times。 我们还发现，经过训练的 Qwen 模型能够根据问题难度大致线性地分配搜索预算——这是一种涌现的搜索扩展行为。 据我们所知，我们是首次证明：在基于规则生成的合成环境中通过强化学习进行微调的现成大型语言模型，能够构建出在真实世界中表现优异的大型语言模型搜索智能体。

paragraphs.en: Transfer alone, however, does not tell us how fictional worlds compare to real training data. Head-to-head against Search-R1-style training in a real Wikipedia-2018 environment, the real-world environment (expectedly) wins on the in-domain Wikipedia-2018 benchmarks. On benchmarks built from more recent Wikipedia snapshots, however, its advantage narrows for every model and disappears for Qwen models. The cleanest evidence comes from the SynthWorlds real-vs-synthetic-mirror pair: training with real-world data preserves and even widens the gap between SynthWorlds-RM and SynthWorlds-SM evaluation, while training in PhantomEnvironments closes it. The real environment lets the agent shortcut through memorized Wikipedia facts, whereas the fictional one denies that route and forces models to learn and apply the fundamental search skill.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，仅通过迁移无法告诉我们虚构世界与真实训练数据相比如何。 在真实的 Wikipedia-2018 环境中，与 Search-R1 风格的训练方式进行直接对比时，真实世界环境（不出所料）在领域内 Wikipedia-2018 基准测试中胜出。 然而，在基于较新 Wikipedia 快照构建的基准测试中，其优势在所有模型中都逐渐缩小，并在 Qwen 模型中完全消失。 最清晰的证据来自 SynthWorlds 的真实与合成镜像对比对：使用真实世界数据进行训练不仅保留了 SynthWorlds-RM 和 SynthWorlds-SM 评估之间的差距，甚至进一步拉大了这一差距；而在 PhantomEnvironments 中训练则缩小了这种差距。 真实环境允许智能体通过记忆中的维基百科事实走捷径，而虚构环境则阻断了这一路径，迫使模型必须学习并运用基本的搜索技能。

paragraphs.en: As generation is rule-based, we can also vary the question distribution to isolate which axes of environment complexity drive transfer. Constraint questions, counterintuitively, hurt: agents learn to retrieve gold documents with a single verbatim query that exploits rare attributes. This causes the models to skip question decomposition entirely, a necessary skill for real-world agentic search. paragraphs.en: Together, these results position rule-generated synthetic environments as a new source of agent training data, complementary to human-curated and LLM-generated ones. Rule-generated environments add what neither can: training signal for RL that is zero-marginal-cost, exactly verifiable, and never goes stale. The promise comes with limitations—they lag on in-domain benchmarks where knowledge memorization helps, and must be designed to avoid reward shortcuts. The core finding stands: environments built from rules alone train capable LLM search agents.

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement Learning for LLM Search Agents. Following the success of outcome-based RL for reasoning in LLMs ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , a line of work has trained LLM search agents to interleave retrieval with chain-of-thought. Search-R1 ( Jin et al., 2025b ) pairs a Wikipedia index with exact-match rewards; follow-ups vary the optimization but not the data source, exploring multi-stage training ( Song et al., 2025 ) , tighter reasoning–retrieval coupling ( Chen et al., 2025b ) , live web environments ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) , step-level reward shaping ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and modular designs ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) . In this work, we compare the two extremes of synthetic-real environment spectrum: our rule-generated synthetic environments vs the real-world NQ+HotpotQA (multi-hop questions referencing the Wikipedia 2018 corpus ( Kwiatkowski et al., 2019 ; Yang et al., 2018 ) ). We treat the environment as the design surface and ask which axes of question complexity drive transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 用于 LLM 搜索智能体的强化学习。 继基于结果的强化学习在 LLM 推理中取得成功（Guo 等人，2025）之后，一系列研究开始训练 LLM 搜索智能体，使其将信息检索与思维链过程交替进行。 Search-R1（Jin 等人，2025b）将维基百科索引与精确匹配奖励相结合；后续研究在优化方法上有所变化，但数据源保持不变，并探索了多阶段训练（Song 等人，2025）、更紧密的推理-检索耦合（Chen 等人，2025b）、实时网络环境（Zheng 等人，2025）、步骤级奖励塑造（Wang 等人，2025）以及模块化设计（Jiang 等人，2025）。 在本项工作中，我们比较了合成环境与真实环境谱系上的两个极端：我们基于规则生成的合成环境，与真实世界的 NQ+HotpotQA（多跳问题，引用维基百科 2018 语料库（Kwiatkowski 等人，2019；Yang 等人，2018））。 我们将环境视为设计界面，并探究问题的哪些复杂性维度能够促进能力迁移。

paragraphs.en: Synthetic Environment Design for Agent Training. To reduce the time and cost of hand-curating RL training environments at scale, recent work uses LLMs to synthesize training data: either by simulating retrieval responses ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , by generating QA pairs and multi-step trajectories ( Gao et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Goldie et al., 2025 ; Chang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) , or by creating full task harnesses for agents ( Gandhi et al., 2026 ) . While LLMs can generate synthetic training data at scale, they introduce hallucination risk and potential benchmark contamination, from real-world knowledge memorized during LLM training. Creating every training data point incurs non-trivial API cost. Moreover, LLM-generated data is subject to the LLM’s capability ceiling.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体训练的合成环境设计。 为了减少大规模人工构建强化学习训练环境所需的时间和成本，近期的研究利用大语言模型（LLM）来合成训练数据：通过模拟检索响应（Sun et al., 2025）、生成问答对和多步轨迹（Gao et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2026；Goldie et al., 2025；Chang et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026；Lu et al., 2025），或者为智能体创建完整的任务框架（Gandhi et al., 2026）。 尽管大语言模型能够大规模生成合成训练数据，但它们也会带来幻觉风险以及潜在的基准污染问题，这些风险源于大语言模型在训练过程中记忆的现实世界知识。 生成每一个训练数据点都会产生不可忽略的API成本。 此外，大语言模型生成的数据会受到其能力上限的限制。

paragraphs.en: A parallel pre-LLM tradition generates training environments procedurally through rules, entirely free of LLMs. BabyAI ( Chevalier-Boisvert et al., 2019 ) established the rule-generated paradigm in gridworlds; RandomWorld ( Sullivan et al., 2025 ) more recently applies type-guided sampling to synthesize tool-use API call sequences—though it still relies on an LLM to populate environment values and instructions. Both show transfer to real-world benchmarks. On the evaluation front, PhantomWiki ( Gong et al., 2025 ) , SynthWorlds ( Gu et al., 2025 ) , GSM- ∞ \infty ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) use rule-generated fictional worlds to measure LLM reasoning separately from memorized knowledge. Closest to our setting, Kabra et al. (2026) and Stojanovski et al. (2025) train on rule-generated synthetic data and show transfer to real-world reasoning. However, they are limited to the much simpler in-context reasoning setting, where all relevant documents are supplied in the prompt, and LLMs need only compose knowledge ( Kabra et al., 2026 ) . The agentic reasoning setting we study is substantially harder: the LLM receives only the question and no documents upfront. It must (1) discover the relevant documents by formulating queries, (2) recover from irrelevant retrievals from the environment, and finally (3) compose knowledge across many environment interactions. We build on PhantomWiki to an interactive multi-turn RL environment, with no humans or LLMs anywhere in the environment generation pipeline, and exact Prolog-grounded verifiability ( Table 1 ) ( Sterling & Shapiro, 1994 ) . These PhantomEnvironments are thus zero-marginal-cost for generating data. Moreover, their complexity design is controllable rather than being set by an LLM’s capabilities.

sents.en: However, they are limited to the much simpler in-context reasoning setting, where all relevant documents are supplied in the prompt, and LLMs need only compose knowledge ( Kabra et al., 2026 ) .

sents.en: The agentic reasoning setting we study is substantially harder: the LLM receives only the question and no documents upfront.

sents.en: It must (1) discover the relevant documents by formulating queries, (2) recover from irrelevant retrievals from the environment, and finally (3) compose knowledge across many environment interactions.

sents.en: We build on PhantomWiki to an interactive multi-turn RL environment, with no humans or LLMs anywhere in the environment generation pipeline, and exact Prolog-grounded verifiability ( Table 1 ) ( Sterling & Shapiro, 1994 ) .
sents.zh: 我们以PhantomWiki为基础，构建了一个交互式多回合强化学习环境，该环境的生成流程中完全不存在人类或LLM，并且具备基于Prolog的精确可验证性（表1）（Sterling & Shapiro，1994）。

sents.en: These PhantomEnvironments are thus zero-marginal-cost for generating data.
sents.zh: 因此，这些PhantomEnvironments在数据生成方面具有零边际成本。

sents.en: Moreover, their complexity design is controllable rather than being set by an LLM’s capabilities.
sents.zh: 此外，其复杂性的设计是可控的，而非由LLM的能力所决定。

paragraphs.en: Multi-Hop Reasoning and Retrieval. Multi-hop question answering, requiring evidence chains across multiple documents, has been the dominant testbed for retrieval-augmented reasoning. A series of increasingly controlled benchmarks—HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) , 2WikiMultihopQA ( Ho et al., 2020 ) , and MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) —has driven progress on this task, each tightening controls against reasoning shortcuts. SynthWorlds ( Gu et al., 2025 ) and FRAMES ( Krishna et al., 2025 ) pose harder variants requiring integration across more sources under complex constraints. On the method side, IRCoT ( Trivedi et al., 2023 ) showed that interleaving retrieval with reasoning beats single-shot retrieval, with later work regulating retrieval through reflection tokens ( Asai et al., 2023 ) or graph-organized corpora ( Gutiérrez et al., 2024 ) . ReAct introduced the agentic search setting: agents reason to retrieve information with search queries to a search engine requirement ( Yao et al., 2022 ) . These methods collectively underscore that effective multi-hop search requires tight coupling between retrieval and reasoning at each step—precisely the skill our synthetic environments are designed to elicit, without relying on any real-world factual content.
paragraphs.zh: 多跳推理与检索。 多跳问答任务需要跨越多个文档构建证据链，一直是检索增强推理的主要测试场景。 一系列控制程度逐步加强的基准数据集——HotpotQA（Yang 等人，2018）、2WikiMultihopQA（Ho 等人，2020）和 MuSiQue（Trivedi 等人，2022）——推动了该任务的发展，每个数据集都进一步限制了推理中的捷径行为。 SynthWorlds（Gu 等人，2025）和 FRAMES（Krishna 等人，2025）提出了更具挑战性的变体，要求在复杂约束下整合更多来源的信息。 在方法层面，IRCoT（Trivedi 等人，2023）表明，将检索与推理交替进行的效果优于单次检索；后续研究则通过反思标记（Asai 等人，2023）或图结构化的语料库（Gutiérrez 等人，2024）对检索过程进行调控。 ReAct 引入了智能体搜索范式：智能体通过推理生成搜索查询，向搜索引擎检索信息（Yao 等人，2022）。 这些方法共同表明，有效的多跳搜索需要在每一步实现检索与推理的紧密耦合——这正是我们的合成环境旨在激发的能力，且无需依赖任何真实世界的事实内容。

paragraphs.en: In these fictional worlds, people are connected through family and friendship relationships; articles about people are generated with programmed templates. Questions are generated with context-free grammars, and every question-answer pair is fully verifiable by construction. Concretely, we sample relational chains of up to 7 linear hops over the underlying graph from the grammar ( the sister of the friend of the parent of Alice ). Each sampled question compiles to a parallel Prolog query that returns ground-truth answers; a question can have multiple answers. See Section A.4 for details.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些虚构世界中，人们通过家庭和友谊关系相互连接；关于人物的文章则通过编程模板生成。 问题由上下文无关文法生成，且每个问题-答案对都可以通过其构造过程完全验证。 具体来说，我们从文法中采样最多包含 7 个线性跳步的底层图关系链（例如：爱丽丝父母的朋友的姐妹）。 每个采样出的问题都能编译为一个平行的 Prolog 查询，该查询会返回真实答案；一个问题可以有多个回答。 详见第 A.4 节。

paragraphs.en: We collect all templated articles of individuals in a fictional world into a search index, turning PhantomWiki into a search environment where documents can be retrieved by querying. The retrieval interface matches the real-world search setting; only the underlying documents are fictional and rule-generated. This enables an agent to learn—in fictional worlds—how to issue targeted queries and compose knowledge across multiple turns.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将虚构世界中所有个体的模板化文章收集到搜索索引中，使 PhantomWiki 成为一个可以通过查询检索文档的搜索环境。 该检索界面与现实世界的搜索设置一致；只有底层的文档是虚构的且由规则生成。 这使得智能体能够在虚构世界中学习如何发出针对性查询，并在多个回合中整合知识。

paragraphs.en: GRPO and reward design. We use the GRPO algorithm where the model generates multiple independent trajectories for a question and is rewarded only on the final answer ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . Following standard practice in RL fine-tuning, we mask out environment’s outputs within <information>...</information> when calculating the GRPO objective to update the model’s weights ( Jin et al., 2025b ) . We train on ≈ \approx 55K questions in our synthetic environments. To compare with real-world training data, we randomly subsample 55K questions (same data budget) from the NaturalQuestions-HotpotQA (NQ+HotpotQA) corpus released with Search-R1 ( Jin et al., 2025b ) . A question in PhantomEnvironments can have multiple ground-truth answers and an LLM can output multiple predictions separated by commas, so we use the F1 score for reward, after SQuAD-style text normalization ( Rajpurkar et al., 2016 ) . When questions have 1 final answer, as is the case for NQ+HotpotQA questions, the F1 score reward is the same as Exact Match reward.
paragraphs.zh: GRPO 与奖励设计。 我们使用 GRPO 算法，其中模型会针对一个问题生成多个独立轨迹，并且仅根据最终答案获得奖励（Shao et al., 2024）。 遵循强化学习微调的标准做法，在计算 GRPO 目标以更新模型权重时，我们会屏蔽环境在 <information>...</information> 范围内的输出（Jin et al., 2025b）。 我们在合成环境中训练了约 \approx 55K 个问题。 为了与真实世界的训练数据进行比较，我们从随 Search-R1 一同发布的 NaturalQuestions-HotpotQA（NQ+HotpotQA）语料库中随机抽取了 55K 个问题作为子样本（数据量相同）（Jin et al., 2025b）。 PhantomEnvironments 中的一个问题可能有多条真实答案，而 LLM 也可以输出由逗号分隔的多个预测结果，因此我们在进行 SQuAD 风格的文本归一化后，使用 F1 分数作为奖励（Rajpurkar et al., 2016）。 当问题只有一个最终答案时（如 NQ+HotpotQA 中的问题），F1 分数奖励与完全匹配奖励相同。

paragraphs.en: Training details. We fix the training setup so that any difference in transfer is attributable to only the training environment. To encode documents of each environment and search queries, we use intfloat/e5-base-v2 model ( Wang et al., 2022 ) for dense retriever with a flat FAISS index, and fetch top-3 documents per query ( Johnson et al., 2019 ) . We RL full fine-tune four LLMs of different families and sizes: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, and Phi-4-mini-instruct ( Team, 2024 ; Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Microsoft et al., 2025 ) . We train every setting for 1 epoch, with 2 independent training seeds, in our compute budget of 2 B200s over 2 days. Throughout evaluation results in Section 4 we compute mean and standard errors on both training seeds. We use the open-source SkyRL library ( Cao et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 训练细节。 我们固定了训练设置，以确保任何迁移差异仅由训练环境引起。 为了对每个环境的文档和搜索查询进行编码，我们使用 intfloat/e5-base-v2 模型（Wang 等人，2022）作为密集检索器，配合扁平的 FAISS 索引，并为每个查询获取排名前三的文档（Johnson 等人，2019）。 我们通过强化学习对四个不同家族和规模的 LLM 进行了完整微调：Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 和 Phi-4-mini-instruct（Team，2024；Grattafiori 等人，2024；Microsoft 等人，2025）。 我们在为期 2 天、使用 2 台 B200 计算设备的预算内，对每种设置训练了 1 个周期，并使用了 2 个独立的训练种子。 在第 4 节的评估结果中，我们对两个训练种子都计算了均值和标准误差。 我们使用了开源的 SkyRL 库（Cao 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate across Wikipedia-based benchmarks capturing different facets of multi-hop search: standard 2–4 multi-hop datasets (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue), newer 2–6 hop benchmarks to disentangle memorization and reasoning (SynthWorlds-RM, SynthWorlds-SM), and a harder benchmark requiring longer reasoning chains of 2–15 hops (FRAMES). Wikipedia reference articles of these benchmarks span across LLM knowledge cutoff dates. paragraphs.en: Table 2 reports the F1 scores on real-world multi-hop agentic search benchmarks before and after RL fine-tuning in PhantomEnvironments. Training on synthetic environments consistently yields significant gains across all six benchmarks and four LLMs (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, Phi-4-mini-instruct). Relative to the base model, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct improves 7.1 × 7.1\times (from 3.8 3.8 F1 score to 27.0 27.0 on SynthWorlds-SM), and at the minimum by 3.2 × 3.2\times for other benchmarks. Both Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and the larger Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct improve on average 1.9 × 1.9\times after RL fine-tuning in PhantomEnvironments, so the performance transfer holds when scaling LLM size. Overall, the gains average 1.7 × 1.7\times F1 on older benchmarks pre-LLM cutoff dates (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue) and 2.2 × 2.2\times on more recent and challenging benchmarks (SynthWorlds-RM, SynthWorlds-SM, and FRAMES): these LLM agents can search in fresh and more difficult real-world settings. Over the course of synthetic training, models do not overfit to the templated questions and fictional universes, and continue to improve on benchmarks ( Figure 2 ). Every training question is only seen once, so training steps is a proxy for training samples. Hence, this shows the benefit of data scaling in LLM agent training.

paragraphs.en: We construct this test scenario by gathering the documents of all six benchmarks into one large pooled search index that simulates noisy search. The pooled corpus is, at the minimum, 1.5 × 1.5\times the size of FRAMES’ corpus alone, and up to 44 × 44\times for SynthWorlds pair. Moreover, it contains interfering and near-duplicate documents: (1) Wikipedia passages of HotpotQA and MuSiQue overlap with long FRAMES articles, and (2) SynthWorlds-RM documents compete with SynthWorlds-SM as they are identical except for real vs fictional facts ( Gu et al., 2025 ) . In Table 3 we ablate agent performance on the choice of retrieval corpus, either benchmark’s own or pooled corpus. Every agent degrades, but only slightly : the Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct base worsens by 1.6 1.6 average F1 score, and the synthetic-trained ones by 1.9 1.9 points (see Tables 6 and 7 for more results). Indeed, agents trained in simplified fictional worlds are robust to large-scale deployments.

paragraphs.en: Training evolution and emergent search scaling behavior. In addition to real-world transfer, PhantomEnvironments allow for fine-grained analysis as they are fully verifiable and deterministically generated. At environment generation time, question difficulties—the number of fictional Wikipedia documents to navigate—is known. Using this feature, we analyze agents’ performance evolution as RL fine-tuning progresses. In Figure 3 (left) we find that F1 scores of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct improve on questions of all difficulties as training progresses ( Figure 7 visualizes evolution of Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Phi-4-mini-instruct). However, a key behavioral difference emerges between LLM families: Qwen2.5 ones learn to automatically issue search calls proportional to question difficulty, exhibiting a clear linear relationship. We call this desirable property “search scaling”, emergent in Qwen2.5 LLMs from environment interaction alone. Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct shows partial search scaling: number of searches grows linearly with question difficulty, then plateaus. On the other hand, Phi-4-mini-instruct in Figure 7 does not display any scaling. This suggests that this property is model-dependent and emergent only for sufficiently capable LLMs. This finding aligns with prior work on how model baseline capabilities influence benefits from further RL fine-tuning ( Gandhi et al., 2025 ; Yue et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: Generalization in unseen environments. One concern with training on a fixed fictional universe is that the LLM could simply memorize the knowledge graph’s facts and retrieve answers by pattern matching. To test fact memorization, in Figure 3 (right) we evaluate on a freshly-generated unseen environment of the same size (Unseen 1K) and a 10 × 10\times larger universe (Unseen 10K). The trained agents match their in-domain F1 score performance at every difficulty level, when the universe size is fixed at 1K. The trend follows at the larger universe of 10K as well, where the performance is slightly worse than Unseen 1K due to the more noisy search environment. Results for Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Phi-4-mini-instruct in Figure 7 . Robust performance to unseen environments confirms that LLM search agents have learned the generalizable agentic search skill.

paragraphs.en: So far we have showed that fictional worlds can teach agentic search. A natural next question is how their transfer compares to training on real-world data. We find that real-world training environments—with its linguistic richness and grounded factual knowledge—outperform synthetic when evaluation benchmarks contain in-domain facts to training, e.g. when Wikipedia cutoffs overlap. When evaluation becomes out-of-domain, however, PhantomEnvironments outperform real-world.
paragraphs.zh: 到目前为止，我们已经表明，虚构世界可以教会智能体如何进行搜索。 一个很自然的后续问题是，它们的能力迁移效果与在真实世界数据上训练的效果相比如何。 我们发现，当评估基准包含训练领域内的事实时（例如维基百科的截止范围存在重叠），真实世界的训练环境——凭借其丰富的语言资源和基于现实的事实知识——表现优于合成环境。 然而，当评估任务超出原有领域时，PhantomEnvironments 的表现则优于真实世界环境。

paragraphs.en: Real-world environments are superior when in-domain to evaluation. In Figure 4 we compare PhantomEnvironments training against a real-world training environment: NQ+HotpotQA questions from the 2018 Wikidump released with Search-R1 ( Jin et al., 2025b ) . Three benchmarks (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue) share the same Wikipedia 2018 corpus, and overlap in factual knowledge to NQ+HotpotQA training. Expectedly, when training and evaluation are in-domain, real-world training data outperforms synthetic for all LLMs: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct in Figure 4 (a) gets an average 56.7 % 56.7\% F1 score vs 52.2 % 52.2\% respectively (see Figures 8 , 9 and 10 for other LLM results).
paragraphs.zh: 当训练环境与评估环境属于同一领域时，真实世界环境更具优势。 在图4中，我们将PhantomEnvironments的训练环境与一个真实世界的训练环境进行了比较：即使用Search-R1（Jin et al., 2025b）发布的2018年Wikidump数据中的NQ+HotpotQA问题。 三个基准数据集（HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、MuSiQue）共享相同的维基百科2018年语料库，并且其事实性知识与NQ+HotpotQA训练数据存在重叠。 不出所料，当训练和评估均处于同一领域时，对于所有大型语言模型而言，真实世界的训练数据都优于合成数据：图4(a)中的Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct模型的平均F1分数为56.7%（56.7\%），而其他模型分别为52.2%（52.2\%）（其他大型语言模型的结果请参见图8、9和10）。

The story changes on SynthWorlds-RM, SynthWorlds-SM, and FRAMES benchmarks that are sourced from Wikipedia post 2023. NQ+HotpotQA data now has limited factual knowledge overlap, so evaluation is out-of-domain in factual knowledge. Here PhantomEnvironments outperform real-world data: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct in Figure 4 (b) with PhantomEnvs gets an average 32.1 % 32.1\% F1 score vs 28.4 % 28.4\% . This suggests that PhantomEnvironments yield LLM agents robust to distribution shift. We further corroborate this hypothesis with the SynthWorlds pair: SynthWorlds-RM (real Wikidata entities) and SynthWorlds-SM (the same graph re-instantiated with synthetic entities) ( Gu et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.en: This contrast shows the need for training environments that are robust when evaluation targets fall beyond LLM training cutoffs—and our PhantomEnvironments meet this need. Both human-curated and LLM-generated data are anchored to a timed snapshot of the world, so benchmarks built on later snapshots eventually fall outside their coverage. Rule-generated synthetic environments are decoupled from this temporal drift, timeless in a way, and robust to knowledge memorization. In new evaluation environments where such shortcuts through memorization are absent, PhantomEnvironments generalize better than real-world training.
paragraphs.zh: 这种对比表明，我们需要训练环境具备足够的鲁棒性，以应对评估目标超出 LLM 训练数据截止范围的情况——而我们的 PhantomEnvironments 正好满足了这一需求。 无论是人工整理还是 LLM 生成的数据，都锚定在某一特定时间点的世界快照上，因此基于后续快照构建的基准测试最终会超出其覆盖范围。 由规则生成的合成环境与此种时间漂移无关，某种意义上是永恒的，并且对知识记忆具有鲁棒性。 在没有通过记忆实现捷径的新评估环境中，PhantomEnvironments 比真实世界训练更能实现良好的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: Real-world questions span a spectrum of complexity, such as requiring multiple hops over entities, comparing and combining parallel hop chains, and filtering candidates by constraints. We ablate our synthetic environments along three orthogonal axes of complexity: linear hops over entities, comparisons of attributes, and constraints that filter candidates. Holding the corpus fixed, we generate these synthetic environments by extending PhantomEnvironments generation code, context-free-grammars, and Prolog queries. We then fine-tune Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct.
paragraphs.zh: 现实世界中的问题涵盖了各种复杂程度，例如需要跨越多个实体进行多跳推理、比较和组合平行的推理链，以及通过约束条件筛选候选项。 我们从三个正交的复杂性维度对合成环境进行了消融研究：跨实体的线性跳跃、属性比较，以及用于筛选候选项的约束条件。 在保持语料库不变的前提下，我们通过扩展 PhantomEnvironments 的生成代码、上下文无关文法和 Prolog 查询来构建这些合成环境。 随后，我们对 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 和 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 进行了微调。

paragraphs.en: The original Hops environment has questions of up to 7 linear hops from an anchor person ( Who is the friend of parent of Alice ) or a tail attribute ( whose hobby is birdwatching ). The new Hops +Comparisons environment pairs two such chains and adds a comparison predicate to the front ( Who is older, friend of parent of Alice, or sister of Bob? ). We balance the training mixture to 50–50 between pure-hop and comparison questions. Finally, the new Hops +Constraints environment inserts up to three attribute filters at arbitrary positions along the chain ( Who is the friend, whose hobby is reading, of parent of Alice? ), with the same 50–50 balance between pure-hop (0–1 filters) and multi-constraint (2–3 filters) questions. Full specifications are in Section A.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 原始 Hops 环境中的问题最多包含从锚定人物（“谁是 Alice 父母的友人？”）或尾部属性（“谁的爱好是观鸟？”）出发的 7 次线性跳转。 新的 Hops +Comparisons 环境将两条这样的链进行配对，并在其前添加一个比较谓词（“谁年长：Alice 父母的友人，还是 Bob 的姐妹？”）。 我们将训练混合比例在纯跳转问题和比较问题之间设为 50–50。 最后，新的 Hops +Constraints 环境会在链中任意位置插入最多三个属性过滤器（“谁是 Alice 父母、且爱好是阅读的友人？”），同时保持纯跳转问题（0–1 个过滤器）与多约束问题（2–3 个过滤器）之间的 50–50 平衡。 完整规范见第 A.4 节。

paragraphs.en: Not every complexity axis equally drives transfer. One might expect that adding complexity axes only adds to performance transfer. However, Figure 5 shows otherwise—Hops is at least as good as Hops +Comparisons and Hops +Constraints, so linear hops is the dominant complexity axis for performance transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 并非所有复杂性维度都能同等程度地促进迁移。 人们或许会认为，增加复杂性维度只会提升性能迁移效果。 然而，图5显示情况恰恰相反——Hops 的性能至少与 Hops +Comparisons 和 Hops +Constraints 相当，因此线性跳数（linear hops）是性能迁移的主要复杂性维度。

paragraphs.en: Where exactly do the complexity axes help or hurt? Aggregate F1 scores obscure behavioral changes in agents introduced by environment variants. In Figures 6 and 11 we decompose performance by question category on CofCA and 2WikiMultihopQA benchmarks, which contain category labels for questions (see Section A.6 for details on category labels). Both have comparison questions, which our respective environments Hops +Comparisons and Hops +Constraints directly target. We note three observations. First, comparison training questions targets the matching real-world category: Hops +Comparisons significantly outperforms the Hops +Constraints and just Hops. The gain from Hops +Comparisons is most pronounced for Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, which has a low base F1 score for CofCA comparison questions. So environment complexity axes can improve base models on question types on which they are particularly weak. Second, linear hops remain the dominant axis of complexity for transfer on non-comparison categories. Third, we find shortcutting behavior with Hops +Constraints—agents issue verbatim search queries rather than decomposing—and that actively hurts transfer ( Section B.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 复杂性维度究竟在哪些方面提供了帮助或造成了阻碍？ 汇总的 F1 分数掩盖了环境变体所引入的智能体行为变化。 在图 6 和图 11 中，我们按问题类别对 CofCA 和 2WikiMultihopQA 基准测试中的性能进行了分解，这些基准测试包含问题的类别标签（有关类别标签的详细信息，请参见第 A.6 节）。 两者都包含比较类问题，而我们的相应环境 Hops +Comparisons 和 Hops +Constraints 直接针对这类问题。 我们注意到以下三点观察结果。 首先，比较类训练问题针对的是与现实世界相对应的类别：Hops +Comparisons 的性能显著优于 Hops +Constraints 和仅使用 Hops 的环境。 Hops +Comparisons 带来的提升在 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 上最为明显，因为该模型在 CofCA 比较类问题上的基础 F1 分数较低。 因此，环境复杂性维度能够提升基础模型在那些它表现特别薄弱的问题类型上的性能。 其次，对于非比较类别的迁移任务而言，线性跳步仍然是主导的复杂性维度。 第三，我们在 Hops +Constraints 环境中发现了捷径行为——智能体直接发出原封不动的搜索查询而非进行问题分解——而这种现象实际上会损害迁移效果（参见第 B.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: We show that LLM search agents trained in PhantomEnvironments, with no humans or LLMs in the data pipeline, transfer to real-world multi-hop search. Real training data wins where memorized knowledge helps, but its advantage narrows on benchmarks built from newer Wikipedia snapshots. Ablating environment complexity reveals that linear hops drive most of the transfer, comparison questions target their matching real-world category, and constraint questions backfire by rewarding a verbatim-query shortcut. In this work, we find rule-generated synthetic environments as a zero-marginal-cost and effective source of agent training data.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，在 PhantomEnvironments 中训练、且数据流程中不包含人类或大型语言模型（LLM）的 LLM 搜索智能体，能够迁移到现实世界中的多跳搜索任务。 在记忆知识有用的场景下，真实的训练数据表现更优；但在基于较新维基百科快照构建的基准测试中，其优势逐渐缩小。 通过消除环境复杂性的实验可以发现：线性跳转是迁移效果的主要驱动因素，比较类问题会针对现实世界中与之匹配的分类进行推理，而约束类问题则适得其反，因为它奖励了逐字查询的捷径策略。 在本研究中，我们发现规则生成的合成环境是一种零边际成本且高效的智能体训练数据来源。

sents.zh: 在本研究中，我们发现规则生成的合成环境是一种零边际成本且高效的智能体训练数据来源。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. Our complexity analysis invites further work on environment composition: given a known capability gap, can one read off a recipe of synthetic axes that closes it? We use synthetic environments as standalone; blending them with real-world data, e.g., as mid-training data, is a natural next step. Compute budgets limit us from training larger LLMs and evaluating on long-context and open-web benchmarks like BrowseComp-Plus ( Chen et al., 2025c ) —all open directions.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 我们的复杂度分析为环境构成方面的进一步研究提供了方向：在已知能力差距的情况下，能否据此推导出一种合成轴的组合方案来弥合这一差距？ 我们将合成环境作为独立单元使用；将其与真实世界数据相结合（例如，用作训练中期数据），是顺理成章的下一步。 计算资源限制使我们无法训练更大规模的 LLM，也无法在长上下文和开放网络基准测试（如 BrowseComp-Plus (Chen et al., 2025c)）上进行评估——这些都是有待探索的开放方向。

paragraphs.en: We optimize the policy with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) , following Search-R1 ( Jin et al., 2025b ) and the SkyRL implementation ( Cao et al., 2025 ) . For each question we sample G = 8 G=8 rollouts from the current policy and assign each trajectory a reward: F1 score reward between 0 and 1 for training in our rule-generated synthetic environments. For NQ+HotpotQA training of Search-R1 that has only 1 ground-truth answer, F1 score becomes Exact Match reward of 0 or 1.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用群体相对策略优化（GRPO）（Shao 等人，2024；Guo 等人，2025）来优化策略，该方法遵循 Search-R1（Jin 等人，2025b）以及 SkyRL 实现方案（Cao 等人，2025）。 对于每个问题，我们从当前策略中采样 G = 8 次 rollout，并为每条轨迹分配一个奖励：在我们基于规则生成的合成环境中进行训练时，使用介于 0 和 1 之间的 F1 分数作为奖励。 在 Search-R1 的 NQ+HotpotQA 训练中，由于每个问题只有一个标准答案，F1 分数将转化为精确匹配奖励，取值为 0 或 1。

paragraphs.en: Training dynamics and instability . For a couple of real-world training data runs, we observed entropy spikes and training degeneration in Phi-4-mini-instruct and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct models, often ≈ 50 % \approx 50\% into the run. This occurred on 1 training seed for Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct on synthetic ablation Hops +Constraints as well. In such cases, we report the prior saved policy checkpoint with the best held-out set performance. We rule out PhantomEnvironments as the cause, as we observe model degeneracy in real-world training data and one-off training seeds. Such RL training instability is observed in practice, even at frontier scale: MAI-Thinking-1 frequently observed crashes and restarted with heuristics ( Team, 2026 ) . Identifying the cause is an interesting open research direction.
paragraphs.zh: 训练动态与不稳定性。 在几轮真实世界训练数据的运行中，我们观察到 Phi-4-mini-instruct 和 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 模型出现熵值骤升和训练退化现象，通常发生在运行过程的大约 50% \approx 50\% 处。 在合成消融 Hops +Constraints 数据集上，Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 的一个训练种子也出现了这种情况。 在这种情况下，我们报告先前保存的策略检查点，该检查点在保留测试集上的表现最佳。 我们排除了 PhantomEnvironments 是原因的可能性，因为我们在真实世界训练数据和单次训练种子中都观察到了模型退化现象。 这类强化学习训练不稳定性在实践中确实存在，即使在前沿规模也是如此：MAI-Thinking-1 经常观察到崩溃，并借助启发式方法重启（Team, 2026）。 确定其根本原因是一个有趣且尚未解决的研究方向。

paragraphs.en: At every search turn, the LLM policy queries a locally served dense retrieval index built with FAISS ( Johnson et al., 2019 ) . We use exact (flat) search and return the top-3 passages for each query. Each evaluation benchmark contributes its own retrieval corpus, constructed from the gold and distractor paragraphs accompanying its question set. The one exception is FRAMES, for which we download Wikipedia articles at the June 2023 revision cutoff that matches the benchmark’s authoring snapshot, and chunk them into section-level passages.
paragraphs.zh: 在每次搜索回合中，LLM 策略都会查询一个由 FAISS（Johnson 等人，2019）构建的本地密集检索索引。 我们使用精确（扁平）搜索，并为每个查询返回排名前三的段落。 每个评估基准都提供其专属的检索语料库，该语料库由与其问题集配套的正确答案段落和干扰段落构成。 唯一的例外是 FRAMES：我们下载截至 2023 年 6 月修订版本的维基百科文章，这些文章与基准的撰写快照相匹配，并将其分块为章节级别的段落。

paragraphs.en: During training, both the synthetic and real-world corpora are encoded with intfloat/e5-base-v2 (768 dimensions) ( Wang et al., 2022 ) . This is the same encoder used by Search-R1, so the training retriever is fixed across synthetic and real-world environments, ensuring that differences in downstream performance reflects the training data source.

paragraphs.en: At evaluation time we switch to a stronger encoder, Qwen3-Embedding-4B (2560 dimensions), and apply it uniformly across all evaluation benchmarks. Prior work has noted that retriever quality at evaluation time is a major confound when comparing LLM agents, and recommend using the best available search retriever index ( Jin et al., 2025a ; Chen et al., 2025c ) . Therefore, we standardize evaluation on the high-quality Qwen3-Embedding-4B retriever, and isolate the significance of our results to the training setup alone. In Tables 4 and 5 , evaluation results are slightly worse—across the board—when we use the training setup during evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 在评估阶段，我们切换到性能更强的编码器 Qwen3-Embedding-4B（2560 维），并在所有评估基准中统一使用该编码器。 先前的研究指出，评估阶段的检索器质量是比较 LLM 智能体时的一个主要干扰因素，因此建议采用当前可用的最佳搜索检索器索引（Jin et al., 2025a；Chen et al., 2025c）。 因此，我们将评估标准化为使用高质量的 Qwen3-Embedding-4B 检索器，从而将我们结果的显著性仅归因于训练设置本身。 在表 4 和表 5 中，当我们在评估阶段使用训练设置时，各项评估结果均略有下降。

paragraphs.en: Universes and questions are produced by the PhantomWiki generator ( Gong et al., 2025 ) and our extensions for constraint-bearing and comparison questions. The training universe contains 1,000 1{,}000 individuals organized into 100 100 family trees of up to 10 10 people each, with a maximum tree depth of 10 10 , using PhantomWiki’s easy-mode relation set (questions contain only friendship or immediate family relationships, no derived relationships like grandfather). Each individual is rendered as a single templated article in a wiki-style format; these articles form the documents in the retrieval corpus.

paragraphs.en: Three question-generation configurations are used. In all three, aggregation questions (“how many…”) are filtered out (easy to reward-hack), and gold answers are obtained by executing the Prolog query attached to each template against the universe graph. paragraphs.en: Training sets are balanced so that no difficulty stratum dominates the mixture. For Hops +Constraints, we partition questions into cells of a two-dimensional grid indexed by ( hops , constraints ) (\text{hops},\text{constraints}) and downsample every cell to the size of the smallest cell. This produces a uniform distribution across the grid and yields the 50 / 50 50/50 split between pure-hop and multi-constraint questions reported in Section 5 . For Hops +Comparisons, we partition by ( hops , kind ) (\text{hops},\text{kind}) where kind is one of {base, comparison}, determined from the question surface form. Because the zero-hop comparison cell is small, we apply a soft cap rather than strict equalization: each cell is capped at four times the size of the smallest cell. In both regimes, 10 % 10\% of each balanced cell is held out as a stratified validation split.
paragraphs.zh: 训练集经过平衡处理，以确保没有任何难度层级在混合中占据主导地位。 对于 Hops +Constraints，我们将问题划分为一个二维网格的单元格，该网格由 (hops, constraints) (\text{hops},\text{constraints}) 索引，并对每个单元格进行下采样，使其大小与最小的单元格相同。 这样可以在整个网格上产生均匀分布，并得出第 5 节中报告的纯跳数问题与多约束问题之间的 50/50 分配。 对于 Hops +Comparisons，我们按 (hops, kind) (\text{hops},\text{kind}) 进行划分，其中 kind 是 {base, comparison} 中的一个值，由问题的表层形式确定。 由于零跳数比较单元格较小，我们采用软性上限而非严格的均等化：每个单元格的上限为其最小单元格大小的四倍。 在这两种机制中，每个平衡单元格中的 10\% 被保留为分层验证集。

paragraphs.en: PhantomWiki’s default question sampler grounds relation chains from one fixed end: it picks a starting entity and walks forward through relations until the chain is fully instantiated, with the answer always landing at the final position. This introduces a positional bias. Entities that sit at the periphery of the knowledge graph (leaves of family trees, people with few friends) are over-represented as answers, because they are easy to reach as chain endpoints but rarely serve as starting points.
paragraphs.zh: PhantomWiki 的默认问题采样器从单一固定端点出发构建关系链：它选择一个起始实体，并沿着关系向前推进，直到关系链完全实例化，而答案始终位于最终位置。 这会导致位置偏差。 处于知识图谱边缘的实体（如家族树的叶节点、朋友很少的人）作为答案被过度呈现，因为它们很容易成为关系链的终点，但很少作为起点。

paragraphs.en: We replace this with a bidirectional anchor sampling procedure that allows the answer to occupy any position in the chain. The idea is straightforward: instead of committing to a direction before walking, we first choose an anchor point inside the chain and then extend outward in both directions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们用一种双向锚点采样方法取代了这种方法，该方法允许答案在链中的任何位置。 这个想法很简单：在开始行走之前，我们不预先确定方向，而是先选择链内的一个锚点，然后向两个方向延伸。

paragraphs.en: The anchor strategy can be set to uniform (the default described above), balanced (cycling through start, middle, and end positions equally), or fixed at a specific position for ablation purposes. Under uniform anchoring, the answer is equally likely to appear at any position in the chain, eliminating the directional bias of the original sampler.
paragraphs.zh: 锚定策略可设置为均匀（上文描述的默认设置）、平衡（在起始、中间和结束位置之间循环切换，且概率均等），或为消融研究目的而固定于特定位置。 在均匀锚定模式下，答案出现在链中任意位置的概率均等，从而消除了原始采样器的方向性偏差。

paragraphs.en: The chain topology is fully determined by the CFG template; the bidirectional walker does not introduce new relation sequences. It reads the template as an ordered list of typed slots and fills them outward from the anchor. For multi-constraint questions, where the template attaches attribute predicates (e.g., “whose hobby is painting”) to interior chain variables, the walker checks these predicates during the relevant step and resamples if the drawn entity does not satisfy the constraint.
paragraphs.zh: 链式拓扑完全由 CFG 模板决定；双向行走器不会引入新的关系序列。 它将模板读取为带类型槽位的有序列表，并从锚点向外填充这些槽位。 对于多约束问题，即模板将属性谓词（例如，“其爱好是绘画”）附加到链式内部变量时，行走器会在相关步骤中检查这些谓词，如果抽取到的实体不满足约束，则进行重新采样。

paragraphs.en: In Figures 5 , 6 and 11 , we observed that Hops +Constraints environment showed worse real-world transfer than the other environment complexity axes. We trace it to a shortcut that the Hops +Constraints environment unintentionally rewards during training. A constraint such as a specific date of birth or occupation is information-rich: a single dense-retrieval query that pastes the entire question often surfaces the gold document directly, because the rare attribute alone narrows the candidate set. The agent then never has to resolve the question chain one at a time, and can side-step question decomposition. Once this works in training, the behavior carries over at test time. We observe that the Hops +Constraints-trained agent issues the question verbatim as its first search on an overwhelming majority of real-world trajectories and almost always paraphrases the same query when retrieval fails. Whereas, the Hops-trained agent decomposes questions and reasons explicitly between turns, recovering the correct answer more often. We show one such trajectory pair verbatim below. Real-world benchmarks rarely include the kind of information-rich attribute filters that make the shortcut work, explaining why Hops +Constraints shows worse real-world transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 在图5、6和11中，我们观察到Hops +Constraints环境在实际场景中的迁移效果比其他环境复杂度维度更差。 我们认为这是因为Hops +Constraints环境在训练期间无意中奖励了某种捷径。 像特定出生日期或职业这样的约束条件信息丰富：一个直接粘贴整个问题的密集检索查询通常能直接找到目标文档，因为仅凭这一罕见属性就能缩小候选集范围。 这样一来，智能体就无需逐个解决问题链中的各个问题，而是可以绕过问题分解步骤。 一旦这种模式在训练阶段奏效，它也会延续到测试阶段。 我们观察到，经过Hops +Constraints训练的智能体，在绝大多数实际场景路径中都会原样输出问题作为首次搜索，而当检索失败时，几乎总是会改写相同的查询。 相比之下，经过Hops训练的智能体会对问题进行分解，并在不同步骤间进行明确推理，因此更常能恢复正确答案。 我们在下方以原文形式展示了一对这样的路径示例。 实际场景基准测试很少包含能让这种捷径生效的信息丰富属性过滤器，这解释了为何Hops +Constraints在实际迁移中的表现更差。
